finding: Durable confusable-key auditing requires verification of the exact versioned Unicode data bytes before parsing. Unicode 17 data is published under /Public/17.0.0/security/, while latest aliases are mutable and unsuitable as immutable evidence locators.

primary_sources.title: Unicode Technical Standard #39, Version 17.0.0
primary_sources.observed: Section 7 identifies the versioned Unicode 17 security-data directory and states that data may change across versions.

latest and unversioned source URLs rejected

The manifest records one retrieval and should be independently reproduced before production enforcement.
Unicode source licensing and repository vendoring policy remain separate decisions.
falsification_route: Independently retrieve the exact versioned URL and compare SHA-256, byte length, Version header, and MA record count. A mismatch or parser rejection falsifies the retained identity claim.
